newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following eight municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Akeny, Iowa, $3.9 million of GO and refunding bonds.
--New Orleans, La., $4.5 million and $50 million of public improvement bonds.
--New Hampshire Municipal Bond Bank $24.3 million of Series D bonds.
--Clarence CSD, N.Y., $20.9 million of GO school bonds.
--Katonah-Lewisboro SD, N.Y., $4.3 million of school district bonds.
--Lakeland CSD, N.Y., $5.6 million of school bonds.
--Robertson County, Tenn., $6.6 million of GO school bonds.
